sub_palette: classical (latinate) backbone + mesoamerican (mayan) overlay (cross-family blend, Latinate-leaning)

blend.backbone: classical (latinate register: the -us/-a/-um endings, penultimate stress, the legion and the via, the gens and the cognomen, the Rex/Imperator ladder, vowel-rich open syllables)
blend.overlay: mesoamerican (mayan: the jungle city-states of pyramid-acropolis and stela, the k'uhul ajaw holy-lord and the Long-Count calendar, glottalized stops, jade and cacao and maize, the witz-altar and the feathered-serpent temple)
blend.lean: Latinate-heavy - a legionary aristocracy (an imperial gens-house) enthroned over the Maya jungle-cities of jade and the pyramid: the eagle-standard and the via rule, the stela-carving k'uhul-kah endures and serves beneath. The golden eagle and the jade pyramid; the legion and the feathered-serpent temple.

_note: NEW cross-family hybrid under the base/hybrid model. BASE_06 (Classical/Mediterranean, latinate) x BASE_10 (Mesoamerican, mayan). CIV/CLAN DECIDED by inheritance: both parents are Civilized (latinate civ + mayan civ), so Aurumaya is Civilized (feudal). Concept: a Roman-Mesoamerican realm - a Latinate legion-empire that conquered the Maya jungle city-states and set up as Imperator over the pyramid-temples (Aurum 'gold' + maya). Backbone = Classical/Latinate (the ruling legionary aristocracy, the Rex/Imperator register, the tripartite gens-name); overlay/substrate = Mayan (the jungle terrain, the witz-pyramids, the stela-carving populace, the calendar-day names). Common-word lexicon and rank titles draw on the real Latin and Maya registers (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are morphs of the Agrippan canon from both parents (Latinate canon-morphs PRIMARY, Mayan variants SECONDARY), never real gods. Ruler/domain DISPLAY titles are English (or an approved commonly-known foreign term: 'Imperator' for the empire ruler); conlang titles live in ruler_native/domain_native for NPC dialogue. All human cultures allow Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic. Register choice: Latinate-base hybrids default to the Roman/Latinate reflexes; Maya substrate supplies the jungle/pyramid/material/staple words.

phonology.palette: Classical/Latinate backbone - vowel-rich a e i o u, liquids l/r, sibilant s, sharp stops p t c(=k) b d g, f/v, penultimate stress, open syllables, the -us/-a/-um/-ius endings, the legion-register tripartite names - meeting a Mayan overlay: glottalized b'/t'/k'/tz'/ch', x (=sh), vowel length and the glottal stop, the agentive aj-/ix-, the -aj/-il/-an/-tun/-ab endings, vigesimal (base-20) counting and the Long-Count calendar. Per the CSV: vibrant vowels with precise consonants; grammar SVO with vigesimal case-inflections carried on the Latinate stems. Theophoric on the Latinate reflexes (Tulrian-, Orlandus-) with Maya construct variants (Tulax-, Orlanab-).
phonology.phonotactics: CV / CVC; Latinate onset clusters (st, tr, pr, cl, sp) and vowel-final preference meeting Maya glottalization and the final glottal stop softened to a vowel; penultimate stress; gens-binomials over aj-/ix- + calendar-day substrate names; the -tun/-ab Maya endings Latinized to -tum/-abum where they survive.

sound_changes: Maya glottalized/ejective stops -> Latin plain inventory: b'>b, t'>t, k'>c(=k), tz'>z/s, ch'>c; x(sh)>x/s; final glottal stop ' >0 (or > a linking vowel)
Maya endings drop or Latinize: final -aj/-il/-an/-tun/-ab -> Latin -a/-us/-um/-ia (or -tun>-tum, -ab>-abum); roots take a penultimate-stressed Latinate vowel-final shape
Latinate penultimate stress on all words; Latin clusters (st, tr, pr, cl, sp) permitted; vowel-final endings preferred over the Maya consonant-final/CVC shape
retain Latin -us/-a/-um/-ius and Maya x (=sh) plus vigesimal counting; very short Maya roots take a Latin -um/-us ending; vowel length collapses to plain Latin vowels
fusion_rules.source_tilt: land/terrain/material/staple words from Mayan roots (the jungle substrate works the land - jade, cacao, maize, the witz-pyramid, the ha'-river, the k'aax-forest); kin-line/quality/abstract/rule/war/law words from Latin roots (the ruling register - the gens, the legion, the law, magnus/novus, the via and the imperium); every root then filtered to one Latinate phonology

lexicon._note: Single fused tongue derived via phonology.fusion_rules (gdd-hybrid-conlang-fusion.md): Mayan jungle/pyramid/material/staple roots + Latin rule/kin/law/abstract roots, all run through one Latinate-shaped sound-law (Maya glottals collapsed, endings Latinized to -us/-a/-um, penultimate stress); portmanteaus mark the blended institutions and bloodline. No slashes - one word per concept.

morphology.patronymic_form: the Latinate ruling gens keeps a tripartite name (praenomen + nomen-gens + cognomen); the Maya populace keep the aj- (he of) / ix- (she of) prefix and the ch'ib'al lineage with calendar-day birth-names; the throne fuses both - an Imperator who also carries a witz-dynasty stela-count.
morphology.compounding_rule: Latinate [adjective|resource](stem) + feature-word, eliding before a vowel (aureus + witza -> Aurwitza, the gold-pyramid) layered over Maya [color|quality]-prefix + feature (Chak-ha'a, red-river; Noh-kaha, great-town); the capital Aurumaya (Aurum-maya, the gold-of-the-maya), Chak-Witza (the red-pyramid seat).

title_ladder.government: feudal (a Latinate legion-aristocracy over the Maya jungle-cities: the Imperator and his Rex-kin at the crown, the Comes-governors over the urbkaha city-states, the Castellanus-castellans sworn to the legion; the ah-k'in sun-priests and the stela-carving scribes serve beneath)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Latinate ladder, ascending, with the Maya substrate overlay at the high tiers. Castellanus (castellan; from Roman castellum) barony; Limitanus (frontier-warden; from limes/limitanei) march, leaving Dux for its proper meaning; Comes (companion-governor) county over a Comitatus; Dux (war-leader) duchy over a Ducatus; Princeps fused with the Maya Ajaw (holy-lord) at the principality; Rex (king) kingdom over a Regnum; the Imperator (the approved foreign empire-title) fused with the Maya Kalomte' (overlord/high-king) over the Imperium. The conquered cities keep their Maya sajal (subordinate governor) and ah-k'in (sun-priest) beneath the Latinate crown. Rank titles fuse the real Latin and Maya registers (allowed). Latin/realm size thresholds come from the ACKS domain rules; not reproduced here for IP.
title_ladder.heir: Caesar (heir-designate to the Imperator; the Maya call him the Baah-ch'ok, head-youth)

vassalage.fealty: Fides (Latin troth) / Patan-t'an (Maya oath of service)

title_ladder.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH (or an approved commonly-known foreign term where set in 'ruler': 'Imperator' for the empire ruler). The *_native conlang forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.

people_name_convention.order: the Latinate ruling stock carry a tripartite name (praenomen + nomen-gens + cognomen); the Maya populace carry an aj-/ix- prefix + calendar-day given name + ch'ib'al lineage; order given-first.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the Latinate legion-aristocracy keep the tripartite gens-names (Marcus, Valerius, a cognomen); the Maya city-folk keep aj-/ix- + calendar-day names on the morphed canon-stems.
people_name_convention.theophoric: Latinate devotional on the canon-reflexes (Tulrian-, Orlandus-, Realtus-); Maya devotional constructs: Aj-Tulax (he of Tulax), Ix-Rialtaj (she of Rialtaj), calendar-day-and-power names.

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon - Latinate canon-morphs PRIMARY (family_classical / agrippan canonical pantheon keys, the latinate reflexes), Mayan variants SECONDARY (family_mesoamerican.json theonym_sets.mayan), never real gods (no Itzamna, Kukulkan, Chaac, Jupiter, Mars). Shared pantheon, two registers. Aurumaya allows Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic; its stance follows its CURRENT alignment (see worship_by_alignment). The Long-Count calendar and the witz-pyramid altar bind the Imperator-Kalomte' to the powers as much as the legion-augury does.
religion.the_one: Aeternus (Maya Aj Ternaj) - the One / True God, honored in liturgy not petitioned

sample_deity_renames.Tulrius: Tulrius (Maya Tulax) - the sun and justice
sample_deity_renames.Realta: Realta (Maya Ix Rialtaj) - the mother, mercy

worship_by_alignment.Lawful: venerates the Lawful powers - Aeternus, Tulrius the just (Tulax), Orlandus of the sworn legion (Orlanab), Realta the merciful (Ix Rialtaj) - and names the Chaotic powers as demons, warded; the legion-oath and the calendar-rite bind alike
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: all powers ambivalent - the uchben (ancestral dead, the deified gens and the k'uhul ajaw line), the day-lords and local k'uh (spirits) foregrounded; the great powers invoked at the aedwitza-pyramid and the via-shrine situationally
worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: Venerates the Chaotic powers of the canon (Maraxus the war-fire, the feathered-serpent's dark face), and names the Lawful powers - and Aeternus - as the tyrant-gods to be defied; the bloodletting-rite turned to conquest.

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the Chaotic powers, warded when Lawful, keep their morphs + an epithet: Maraxus -> Maraxus the Tyrant-Flame (Maya Marakab the War-Fire); Vacidus -> Vacidus the Unmaker (Maya Wakix the Devourer); Lusanto -> Lusantus the Coin-Serpent (Maya Lusankaan the Hoard-Serpent).
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Collegium (Latinate) or the K'uh-nah (god-house) atop the witz (pyramid) of [power]: 'the Collegium of Tulrius', 'the K'uh-nah of Tulax'.
religion.saints_pattern: Divus/Diva [name] (the deified founders and the deified k'uhul ajaw ancestors, the uchben), inscribed on the stela and honored at the pyramid-tomb and the via-catacomb.
